'''Master-Grav 1000''' [[Repulsor boots|grav boots]] were a model made by [[Corgorlath Leisure Articles]]. The boots employed [[Repulsor field/Legends|repulsorlift fields]] to allow those who wore them to move at planes 45-180 degrees opposite normal gravity at an altitude of up to 150 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The boots made little noise. They cost 550 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per pair and were popularly used to play a variety of sports.
